description: Historic Traffic Volume 2019 (Constitution Ave & Coranderrk St) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by ACT Government Open Data. This dataset contains historic traffic volume of vehicles passing through road detectors from 1st Jan 2019 to 31st Dec 2019. There are 14 detectors at this road intersection. The schematic diagram of all those detectors are available at data. act. gov. au/Transport/Schematics-of-Road-Detectors/e6rb-gbiq. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher ACT Government Open Data. Its tags are traffic-count, traffic-volume, vehicle-count. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
